text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses user stories from the backlog, a list of tasks and features. Every day, they hold short meetings called standups to discuss progress and problems. This iterative development allows teams to improve the product step by step and respond quickly to change. Agile helps teams stay flexible, communicate better, and deliver value to customers faster and more often.
